_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor from the project's own documentation; no upstream egg.
name: LibreTranslate
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: LibreTranslate is a self-hosted machine translation API with a web page, running offline on Argos Translate's models. Only the languages you choose are downloaded, and an API key is required: the first one is shown in the console, and keys, key-add and key-remove manage them there.
startup: h=$( (python3 --version; cat .raptor-libretranslate.txt) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing LibreTranslate"; rm -rf .venv .raptor-tmp && mkdir -p .raptor-tmp && python3 -m venv .venv && TMPDIR=/home/container/.raptor-tmp .venv/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check -q -r .raptor-libretranslate.txt && rm -rf .raptor-tmp && echo "$h" > .venv/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; export PYTHONWARNINGS="ignore:urllib3"; mkdir -p db; k() { .venv/bin/ltmanage keys --api-keys-db-path db/api_keys.db "$@"; }; if [ ! -f db/api_keys.db ]; then .venv/bin/python -c 'from libretranslate.api_keys import Database; Database("db/api_keys.db")' && echo "LibreTranslate's first API key is $(k add 120) (120 requests a minute). Type keys, key-add <requests a minute> or key-remove <key> in the console to manage keys." || exit 1; fi; exec 3<&0; (while read -r c a <&3; do a=${a%$'\r'}; case "${c%$'\r'}" in keys) k ;; key-add) k add "${a:-60}" ;; key-remove) k remove "$a" ;; "") ;; *) echo "Commands: keys, key-add <requests a minute>, key-remove <key>" ;; esac; done) & set -- --api-keys --api-keys-db-path db/api_keys.db; [ "{{REQUIRE_API_KEY}}" = 1 ] && set -- "$@" --under-attack; exec .venv/bin/python -c 'import logging, sys; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING); import argostranslate.utils; logging.getLogger("argostranslate.utils").setLevel(logging.WARNING); sys.argv[0] = "libretranslate"; from libretranslate.main import main; main()' --host 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --load-only "{{LANGUAGES}}" --char-limit {{CHAR_LIMIT}} --threads {{THREADS}} "$@"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# LibreTranslate: checks the chosen version on PyPI and writes it to
# .raptor-libretranslate.txt; the server installs it (in .venv, for the Python
# version it runs) when it next starts, with the language models chosen.
# The API keys database and downloaded models are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" https://pypi.org/pypi/libretranslate/json) ||
    fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
latest=$(jq -r .info.version <<<"$meta")
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] && want="$latest"
jq -e --arg v "$want" '.releases[$v] | length > 0 and all(.yanked | not)' <<<"$meta" >/dev/null ||
    fail "LibreTranslate has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest, then reinstall."

echo "libretranslate==$want" > .raptor-libretranslate.txt.new
mv -f .raptor-libretranslate.txt.new .raptor-libretranslate.txt
mkdir -p db
echo "Installed LibreTranslate $want; it's set up when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The LibreTranslate release to install from PyPI, such as 1.9.6, or latest.

variables.name: Languages
variables.description: The language codes to translate between, separated by commas, such as en,es,fr,de. Each language downloads about 200 MB of models.

variables.name: Require an API key
variables.description: Refuse translations without a valid API key, the web page's included. Off lets anyone use it.

variables.name: Character limit
variables.description: The most characters one request may translate, or -1 for no limit.

variables.name: Threads
variables.description: How many translations run at once.
